name.description: The name you want to give the new template. In case it exists an error will be thrown.

saveToken.description: The save token you want to create a template from.

directoryId.description: The directory you want to put the newly created template in. Default is the root directory.

clearBuyerSettings.description: Remove all buyer side settings from all frames?

thumbnailUrl.description: The thumbnail url you want to set for the template.

dropshipDataId.description: The dropship data (shipping, address data etc) you want to use for this dropship order.

productDefinitionId.description: The product definition you want to use for dropshipping.

callbackType.description: The callback type you want to use. 0=None, 1=Url, 2=Shopify.

callbackPayload.description: Depending in the callbackType you can specify the url or Shopify shop domain.

linkedOrderLineItems.description: The amount of line items linked together. If your dropship order constists of 5 line items => enter 5 here.

linkedOrderLineItemsId.description: The shared linked id of this order line item. This must match for all line items belonging to the order. A GUID is a good value here.

shippingCode.description: Optional: A shipping code used for dropship shipments to map to the final shipping provider.

shippingTitle.description: Optional: A shipping title used for dropship shipments to map to the final shipping provider. The title has lower priority than the shipping code.

data.description: Optional: Dictionary to set specific dropshipper data.

externalOrderId.description: The external order id you need to provide when producing jobs. This should link to your customer order somehow. Only used for accounting issues.

callbackUrl.description: The url which is called back when a job is finished. It will be called in case of error or success. Response codes 200-299 are considered a success.

templateName.description: The name of the template which you want to produce.

contentTemplateName.description: The name of the template which you want to take exchange content from.

origin.description: The origin for this production request. Can be set freely. Used for searching you orders easily.

usePublishedVersion.description: Take the published version of the template you want to produce. Only used for direct template productions. SaveTokens are not affected by this property.

distributorName.description: Printess can setup special distributors for you. Please contact Printess when you have special distribution needs for production files.

meta.description: Meta data you want to send with the job. This will be delivered in the callback. ONLY when using the callbackUrl.

orderMetaData.description: Meta data you want to save for this order.

outputFiles.description: The files you want to output for this job. You can output multiple files from one template at once.

productType.description: The product type for this order. Used for search and payment.

mergeTemplates.description: This field is only used when you do NOT specify output files. The templates you want to merge.

failureRepeats.description: How often should this job retried in case of an error. Maximum possible is 3. Defaults to 1.

copies.description: How many copies of this file are printed.

outputType.description: What should be output. Possible options are pdf, png, jpg. Everything else will always result in a pdf file.

autoMerge.description: When producing a design which is connected to a base template, activating this setting will automatically merge them as defined.

atomyxProfile.description: The Atomyx profile file path to post process the rendered pdf files. Only works when output type is pdf and you have setup a valid Atomyx access key in the account portal.

combinePdfsIntoOne.description: Combine all pdf output files into one.

printSettingsTemplate.description: The name of the print settings template that should be used for the output

key.description: The unique key of this form field entry. That's the value you can set for the form field.

onlyMyOrders.description: In case your account is pinned to another one, you can set this to true to only see the orders you created.

templateName.description: The name of the template which you want to take and merge into the main production document.

documentName.description: The name of the document you want to merge.

targetDocumentName.description: The name of the document you want to merge to in the target template.

sourceSpreadIndex.description: The spread you want to start merging from. Optional, defaults to 0.

targetSpreadIndex.description: The spread you want to start merging in in the target production document. Optional, defaults to 0.

count.description: How many spreads to take from the merge document. Optional, defaults to number of spreads of the document.

usePublishedVersion.description: Take the published version of the template you want to merge.

transferGlobalFormFieldValues.description: Transfers the global form field values of this template to the merged one.

templateNameIsSnippetId.description: The template name is a snippet id. Merges the snippet, instead of a template.

mergeMode.description: The merge mode. 'overlay' to keep all layout snippet frames.

MergeScopeDto.description: Definition for merge templates. You can merge other templates into the main production document.

jobId.description: The job id associated to this order.

externalOrderId.description: The external order id associated to this order.

sourceUserId.description: The user who issued this order in case it was a pinned user.

templateName.description: The source template which was used for this order.

origin.description: The order origin which was set when creating this order.

shopSaveId.description: The shop save id which was used for this order. Prefix it with 'st:' and set it as template name for the editor and you can load this exact order.

productType.description: The product type which was set for this order.

createdOn.description: The date and time (UTC) when this order was created.

finishedOn.description: The date and time (UTC) when this order completed.

usedImposition.description: The order used an imposition for at least one output file.

documents.description: The amount of documents produced in this order.

copies.description: The number of copies for this order.

pages.description: The amount of pages produced in this order.

size.description: The combined file size (in bytes) of all output files produced.

usedCredits.description: The amount of credits this order costs.

metaData.description: The meta data you sent in the produce call as orderMetaData.

loadableTemplateName.description: The template name you should use for loading within the editor. In case it was a shop order you will see the exact design which was produced.

documentName.description: The name of the document you want to produce.

jpegCompression.description: Jpeg compression in case image optimization is used. Only images which are jpeg are using this setting.

optimizeImages.description: Trades speed for smaller file size. This setting will trim the image to fit the frame exactly.

outputLayers.description: Output the layers in the pdf file. Defaults to false.

outputSpotColors.description: Outputs the spot colors with their name. Defaults to true.

outputDeviceCmyk.description: Use device CMYK. NEVER use this option if you don't know what you are doing.

cropToContent.description: Crop the output to the content. For PDF all boxes (bleed, crop, trim) are set to only contain the content.

taggedPdf.description: Emit pdf tags for frames or multi line paragraphs which have the 'pdfTag' style property.

fps.description: Frames per second when outputting a movie.

linearize.description: Linearize the output pdf. Defaults to false.

allowJpegConversion.description: Allow conversion of image formats with transparency to be converted to jpeg in case they don't have any transparency set. Can result in smaller pdf file sizes. Can degrade image quality a bit. Defaults to false.

setPageNames.description: Sets the spread names as labels for pages in the pdf.

saveToken.description: The save token you got back from the JavaScript Printess API. Always starts with 'st:' and the total length is 89.

expiresOn.description: Expiration date you want to set.

saveToken.description: The saveToken you want to get the details from.
